subject: rt-dym
title: RT.DYM.------POL.P.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-36 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's distinction between two transfer conditions: one 'natural' (connected to spiritual and vibrational factors interconnecting with progressional information) and one 'manufactured' (the result of flaws in the western philosophical and vibrational position). (C)RT-DYM (the concept of reality dynamics) is crossed with POL-P (political policies): the question is what reality-dynamics produces when crossed with political-policies, when the transfer-cycle is being manufactured rather than naturally occurring. IST-PT (isolated particulars) and INFO-DE-B (information-descent basis) form the upper-left and upper-center upstreams. C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) cluster on the upper-right output. CRT (criticism) sits between subject and partner as central hub. AFTD (affinity-tendency) and JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) form the lower upstream chain. CN-INFO (controlled information) anchors the lower-left. ATT (attitude) hangs on the right margin. Structural argument: reality-dynamics crossed with political-policies is mediated by criticism as the central hub, with isolated-particulars and information-descent-basis as upper upstreams and controlled-information plus journalism-dynamics as lower upstreams. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural verdict on manufactured-transfer: political-policies only output composite-culture-attitude and reality-initiative-traits when reality-dynamics is genuinely critical — without the criticism as hub, the crossing collapses into pure attitude (the right-margin output).
